name: EVDA
description: EVDA is a benchmark for evaluating continual learning methods in deepfake audio detection, incorporating classic and newly generated datasets and supporting various continual learning techniques.
reputation: A specialized benchmark in the deepfake audio detection and continual learning literature, but not a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Addresses continual learning for evolving deepfake audio detection; includes datasets from multiple sources and supports integration of new methods.
